[Description]
Description="This template, tool and example enables developers to quickly start implementing the code to execute an applicaiton instead of re-creating the framework to call that code.\0D\0A\0D\0ATLB` (TLB Prime) is the second evolution of the standard event-driven queued message handler. The precursor did nothing to help functionally contain the flow of a program which leads to many issues with program stability.\0D\0A\0D\0ATLB` represents the next evolutionary step in developing more robust and elegant code for the common LabVIEW built application "
Summary="Robust template for the creation of user interface applications and sub-components."

URL="https://github.com/NISystemsEngineering/TLB-Prime/"

The precursor did nothing to help functionally contain the flow of a program which leads to many issues with program stability.\0D\0A\0D\0ATLB` represents the next evolutionary step in developing more robust and elegant code for the common LabVIEW built application "

Display Name="TLB Prime - Application Template"


[Description]
Description="This template, tool and example enables developers to quickly start implementing the code to execute an applicaiton instead of re-creating the framework to call that code.\0D\0A\0D\0ATLB` (TLB Prime) is the second evolution of the standard event-driven queued message handler. The precursor did nothing to help functionally contain the flow of a program which leads to many issues with program stability.\0D\0A\0D\0ATLB` represents the next evolutionary step in developing more robust and elegant code for the common LabVIEW built application "
Summary="Robust template for the creation of user interface applications and sub-components."
License="NI SLA"
Copyright="Copyright (c) 2018, National Instruments"
Distribution=""
Vendor="National Instruments"
URL="https://github.com/NISystemsEngineering/TLB-Prime/"
Packager="NI Systems Engineering"
